messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable mobile 3D open-world zombie survival game in the existing project.

## Requirements
- Third-person exploration and combat in an abandoned city; melee and firearms, varied zombies, loot, vehicles, buildings, and ruined streets.
- Atmospheric 3D visuals, combat feedback, and animations.
- Responsive mobile joystick, camera controls, attack, dodge, and weapon switching; optimize for Android phones.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a browser-based Three.js game in `index.html`, with procedural low-poly environments and touch/keyboard controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html` with a city scene, player and zombie actors, pickups, combat, survival HUD, mobile/desktop controls, and extraction objective.
- Started a local HTTP server on port 3002 for browser testing.

### Active
- Validate the game in a browser, fix any runtime or gameplay issues, and capture/inspect a screenshot.

### Blocked
- Browser validation and screenshot capture have not yet been performed.

## Next Move
1. Open `http://localhost:3002` with `playwright-cli` and inspect console/runtime behavior.
2. Start the game, verify movement/combat/pickups/extraction, and save/read the latest screenshot as requested.
3. Fix issues and summarize implementation and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entire game implementation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Three.js is imported from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.161.0/build/three.module.js`.
- Extracted module syntax check (`node --check /tmp/opencode/game-check.mjs`) completed without output.
